blindSummary:
An overseas territory of a distant metropolitan power; same-sex conduct was decriminalised in 2001 only by formal order of the administering government, after the local legislature had refused; the population is tiny and the social climate conservative.

The risk picture tracks the administering power's legal framework closely, slightly offset by greater local social conservatism.
blindOutOfScope: Laws derive largely from the administering power's framework; local deviations are noted in the summary.

Queer travel archive (Sept 2012): the island's gay social life was decimated by a 1989 hurricane and the 1995 volcano eruption that made the south of the island a wasteland - 'gays are everywhere but hardly here'; recovery partial.

Wire-service report (Jan 2001): the metropolitan state scrapped the laws criminalising homosexuality across all five of its territories in this region by direct formal order after local legislatures refused; religious leaders called it 'totally unacceptable'; the territories appeared resigned to following the order.
